# Know whether FBA or FBM leaves more — and the most you can pay for the unit.

> Free Amazon FBA vs FBM calculator: compare fulfillment paths after expected returns. Get net profit, max buy cost, the return rate that wipes the listing, when inbound placement still beats split freight, and whether aged inventory still beats a removal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
